Reference image for the [[Jokes]] rows on [[Barada]] and [[Nikto]]: Klaatu (Michael Rennie) and the robot Gort in front of their spaceship in the trailer for ''The Day the Earth Stood Still'' (1951).

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:KlaatuandGortdepart.jpg KlaatuandGortdepart.jpg], Wikimedia Commons, a screenshot from the film's trailer.
